fot_token_configured.meaning: a fee-on-transfer token is configured as the disputeToken

dispute_created.meaning: a user has called disputeTree() and sent disputeAmount tokens

fee_deducted_on_deposit.meaning: the FoT token deducted a transfer fee so the contract received less than disputeAmount

resolution_completed.meaning: resolveDispute() completed successfully and cleared the disputer for the valid dispute

recovery_possible.meaning: the stuck dispute can be recovered via recoverERC20() or further deposits without upgrade/migration

assumptions: The dispute is valid and the disputer is an honest user acting in good faith.
The 1000/990 figures are illustrative; the plan is symbolic and does not depend on them.
resolveDispute() is the only function that clears the disputer.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify whether resolveDispute(true) or resolveDispute(false) is attempted first; the plan treats resolution completion as a single observable outcome.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the no_recovery impact; other reported impacts (revert, stuck disputer, blocked tree updates) are handled in separate passes.
resolution_completed and recovery_possible are qualitative Booleans because the report gives no numeric definition of successful completion or recoverability.
